caption: The drawing shows a person in a long, elaborate teal dress with wide, flowing skirts and fitted bodice. The dress is decorated with a colorful floral and paisley pattern in shades of pink, yellow, blue, green, and white. The bodice features intricate lace details at the neckline and sleeves, and the sleeves themselves are long and fitted to the elbow, where they flare out into wide, semi-transparent lace cuffs. The person’s head, arms, and hands are only lightly sketched without color, with the head shown in profile facing to the right and holding a fan in their right hand. The background is plain, light beige, and there are no additional objects or scenery in the drawing.
title: Dress
